quests.title: Quantum Physicist Challenge
quests.description: Explore the mysterious world of quantum physics and modern scientific discoveries!

story.introduction: Welcome to the Quantum Research Laboratory! Dr. Quantum needs your help to understand the strange behavior of particles at the atomic level.

steps.title: Photoelectric Effect Investigation
steps.narrative: Dr. Quantum shows you Einstein's photoelectric effect experiment. Analyze the quantum nature of light!

problem.question: In the photoelectric effect, what happens when the frequency of incident light is below the threshold frequency?
options: Electrons are emitted with low energy
No electrons are emitted regardless of intensity
Electrons are emitted after some delay
problem.correct_answer: No electrons are emitted regardless of intensity
problem.explanation: Below threshold frequency, no photoelectrons are emitted regardless of light intensity, proving the quantum nature of light.
